'''Grigori Samuilovitsch Tseitin''' ({{langx|ru|Григорий Самуилович Цейтин}}, born November 15, 1936, in Leningrad, USSR, deceased August 27, 2022 in Campbell, CA, USA) was a Russian mathematician and computer scientist, who moved to the United States in 1999. He is best known for [[Tseytin transformation|Tseitin transformation]] used in [[SAT solver]]s, Tseitin tautologies used in the proof complexity theory, and for his work on [[Algol 68]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Revised Report on the Algorithmic Language ALGOL 68|website=softwarepreservation.computerhistory.org|publisher=|url=https://softwarepreservation.computerhistory.org/ALGOL/report/Algol68_revised_report-AB-600dpi.pdf|url-status=|format=PDF; 4,42 MB|access-date=2026-02-08|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=A. van Wijngaarden, B.J. Mailloux, J.E.L. Peck, C.H.A. Koster, M. Sintzoff, C.H. Lindsey, L.G.T. Meertens, R.G.Fisker|date=1970|language=en|pages=|quote=}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Tseitin studied mathematics at the Leningrad State University (now [[Saint Petersburg State University]]) from 1951 to 1956. He earned his PhD in 1960 under the supervision of Andrei Andreevich Markov. His dissertation was called "Algorithmic Operators on Constructive Complete Separable Metric Spaces".<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|132861}}</ref> In 1968, he received the Russian doctoral degree (corresponding to a [[habilitation]]) from the same university. From 1960 to 2000 Tseitin worked at the {{ill|Smirnov Research Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics at SPbSU|ru|Научно-исследовательский институт математики и механики имени В. И. Смирнова}}<ref>{{cite web|title=St Petersburg State University / Mathematic-Mechanical Faculty / Smirnov Scientific Research Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics|periodical=Istc.int|publisher=|url=http://www.istc.int/en/institute/10091|url-status=|format=|access-date=2018-12-25|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> and taught classes in computer science at his alma mater.

In 2006, Tseitin was recognized as an [[List of distinguished members of the Association for Computing Machinery|ACM Distinguished Scientist]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Gregory S Tseytin|website=awards.acm.org|publisher=|url=https://awards.acm.org/award-winners/TSEYTIN_3894052|url-status=dead|format=|access-date=2018-12-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200622044754/https://awards.acm.org/award-winners/TSEYTIN_3894052|archive-date=2020-06-22|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref>

== Works ==
* G. S. Tseitin. „On the complexity of derivation in propositional calculus“ in: J. Siekmann and G. Wrightson, editors, ''Automation of Reasoning 2: Classical Papers on Computational Logic 1967–1970'', S. 466–483. Berlin, Heidelberg, 1983.
